    The Chief Executive Officer’s Statement
    行政總裁報告



                               Chen Wangzhi
                                                  陳旺枝

                         Chief Executive Officer 行政總裁


    In 2024, the global situation was complex and rapidly
    evolving. Economic development showed a diverse and
    fragmented landscape under the intertwined influence
    of technological advancements and geopolitical factors.
    The continued acceleration of digital transformation has
    also intensified competition and innovation pressure
    among industries. Under such environment, the
    medical healthcare industry is undergoing changes at
    an unprecedent scale. Amidst this wave of challenges
    and opportunities, under the leadership of the Board,
    all employees of the Group have closely followed our
    development strategy of “Precision healthcare, Efficient
    Management and Sincere Service”, committed to steady
    progress with determination, we navigate our mission
    to save lives with professionalism as our oar and
    conviction as our sail, delivering a track record of solid
    and impactful achievements.

    二零二四年，全球局勢複雜多變，經濟發展在科技
    浪潮與地緣政治的交織影響下，呈現出多元分化的
    態勢。數字化轉型持續加速，也加劇了行業間的競
    爭與創新壓力。在這樣的大環境下，醫療行業正經
    歷著深刻變革。在這充滿挑戰與機遇的浪潮中，本
    集團全體員工在董事會的領導下，緊緊圍繞三精管
    理即「精準醫療、精益管理、精誠服務」的發展戰略，
    堅持穩中求進，奮力拼搏，以專業為槳，以信念為帆，
    在救死扶傷的使命航道上，留下了或深或淺卻堅實
    有力的奮鬥航跡。

            Fair value measurement                                                                   公平值計量

            The Group measures certain of its financial assets at fair value at the end              本集團於各報告期末計量其若干按公
            of each reporting period. Fair value is the price that would be received to              平 值 計 量 的 金 融 資 產。公 平 值 乃 在 市
            sell an asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between          場參與者於計量日期進行的有序交易
            market participants at the measurement date. The fair value measurement                  中出售資產所收取或轉移負債所支付
            is based on the presumption that the transaction to sell the asset or transfer           的 價 格。公 平 值 計 量 乃 基 於 假 設 出 售
            the liability takes place either in the principal market for the asset or liability,     資產或轉移負債的交易於資產或負債
            or in the absence of a principal market, in the most advantageous market                 的主要市場進行或於未有主要市場的
            for the asset or liability. The principal or the most advantageous market                情 況 下，則 於 資 產 或 負 債 的 最 有 利 市
            must be accessible by the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability is            場 進 行。主 要 或 最 有 利 市 場 須 為 本 集
            measured using the assumptions that market participants would use when                   團 可 進 入 的 市 場。資 產 或 負 債 的 公 平
            pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in their           值乃基於市場參與者為資產或負債定
            economic best interest.                                                                  價所用的假設計量（假設市場參與者依
                                                                                                     照彼等的最佳經濟利益行事）。

            A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into account a                   非金融資產公平值的計量則參考市場
            market participant’s ability to generate economic benefits by using the asset            參與者可透過以其最高及最佳效用使
            in its highest and best use or by selling it to another market participant that          用 該 資 產，或 把 該 資 產 售 予 另 一 可 以
            would use the asset in its highest and best use.                                         其最高及最佳效用使用該資產的市場
                                                                                                     參與者產生經濟效益的能力。

            The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in the                          本集團使用適用於有關情況的估值技
            circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to measure fair                術，而 其 有 足 夠 數 據 計 量 公 平 值，以
            value, maximising the use of relevant observable inputs and minimising the               盡量利用相關可觀察輸入數據及盡量
            use of unobservable inputs.                                                              減少使用不可觀察輸入數據。

    the consolidated financial statements are categorised within the fair value         的 所 有 資 產 及 負 債，均 根 據 對 公 平 值
    hierarchy, described as follows, based on the lowest level input that is            計量整體而言屬重大的最低級別輸入

            On 20 December 2024, the directors of the Company resolved to dispose of        於 二 零 二 四 年 十 二 月 二 十 日，本 公 司
            55% equity interests of Kangxin Hospital to Silver Mountain Capital Limited     董事議決向銀山資本有限公司（「銀山
            (“Silver Mountain”) or its affiliates. As the demerger of Kangxin Hospital      資本」）或其聯屬公司出售康心醫院的
            (which was conducted under the laws of the PRC, pursuant to which               55% 股權。隨著康心醫院的分立（乃根
            Chongqing Kanghua Property, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company            據 中 國 法 律 進 行，據 此 已 成 立 本 公 司
            has been established to hold the land and buildings underlying the              全 資 附 屬 公 司 重 慶 康 華 物 業，以 持 有
            operations of Kangxin Hospital) was completed and the land and buildings        康 心 醫 院 經 營 相 關 的 土 地 及 樓 宇）完
            were transferred to Chongqing Kanghua Property on 25 December 2024,             成，且 該 等 土 地 及 樓 宇 已 於 二 零 二 四
            Kangxin Hospital was in a condition ready for immediate sale.                   年十二月二十五日轉讓予重慶康華物

36. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                                          36. 資本風險管理

   The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will be          本集團管理其資本以確保本集團內的
   able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to the              實 體 將 能 持 續 經 營，同 時 透 過 優 化 債
   shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance. The           務及股本平衡盡可能提高股東回報。
   Group’s overall strategy remains unchanged from prior years.                        本集團的整體策略自去年保持不變。

   The capital structure of the Group consists of debts, which include lease           本 集 團 的 資 本 架 構 包 括 債 務，債 務 包
   liabilities, amount due to a non-controlling shareholder of a subsidiary and        括 附 註 15(b)、24 及 25 分 別 披 露 的 租 賃
   bank loans disclosed in notes 15(b), 24 and 25, respectively, net of cash           負 債、應 付 一 間 附 屬 公 司 非 控 股 股 東
   and cash equivalents and equity attributable to owners of the Company,              款項及銀行貸款（扣除現金及現金等價
   comprising share capital and reserves.                                              物）以及本公司擁有人應佔權益（包括
                                                                                       股本及儲備）。

   The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a regular              本 公 司 董 事 定 期 檢 討 資 本 架 構。作 為
   basis. As part of this review, the directors of the Company consider                該 檢 討 的 一 部 分，本 公 司 董 事 考 慮 各
   the cost and the risks associated with each class of capital. Based on              類 資 本 相 關 的 成 本 及 風 險。根 據 本 公
   recommendation of the directors of the Company, the Group will balance              司 董 事 的 推 薦 意 見，本 集 團 將 透 過 支
   its overall capital structure through the payment of dividends, new share           付 股 息、發 行 新 股 以 及 發 行 新 債 務 或
   issues as well as the issue of new debt or the redemption of existing debt.         贖回現有債務平衡其整體資本架構。

   The Group monitors capital using a gearing ratio, which is measured on              本 集 團 採 用 資 本 負 債 比 率（按 計 息 銀
   the basis of the total interest-bearing bank loans divided by the total equity.     行 貸 款 除 以 權 益 總 額 計 量）來 監 控 資
   At 31 December 2024, the Group’s gearing ratio was approximately 15.7%              本。於 二 零 二 四 年 十 二 月 三 十 一 日，
   (2023: 21.3%).                                                                      本 集 團 的 資 本 負 債 比 率 約 為 15.7%（二
                                                                                       零二三年：21.3%）。
